exposure: Degree of meconium stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) (clear, yellow, green, thick)
outcome: Low Apgar scores at five minutes
finding: MSAF was associated with increased risk of adverse outcomes, including pathological fetal heart rate patterns, operative deliveries, need for neonatal resuscitation, low Apgar scores, and fetal-neonatal mortality, with risks increasing as the staining and consistency of the amniotic fluid progressed.
mod_finding: MSAF was associated with a higher proportion of operative vaginal deliveries and cesarean sections.
